chunks: From him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Bukayr, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the bequest to the heir, and he said, 'It is valid.'
ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to leave a bequest to an heir in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* confirms the validity of a testator bequeathing to an heir, a ruling that distinguishes Shia jurisprudence from some Sunni schools which often restrict such bequests to one-third of the estate. By affirming 'tajuz' (it is permissible), Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that the bequest does not require the consent of other heirs, provided it does not exceed the general limits of testamentary disposition. This ruling underscores the flexibility in Shia inheritance law regarding the testator's autonomy over their wealth.
